A Native Scrobbler for Windows 11


Fluent Scrobbler — 1.4.0 Release Notes (2026-11-18)
Fluent Scrobbler 1.4.0 is the final release of the project. Following Last.fm's announcement that holding an active API key will require a Last.fm Pro subscription starting December 1st, 2026, this update transitions the application to a BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) model prior to repository archival.
Important
Because Fluent Scrobbler is a free, open-source application with no financial return, the default developer API key will remain active only as a temporary fallback until December 1st, 2026. After that date, users will need an active Last.fm Pro subscription and their own API credentials to continue scrobbling.
For questions or if you wish to take over and continue maintaining the project, please reach out at: snowmint.dev@gmail.com
What's New
- BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) support: Added a new Last.fm API Credentials (BYOK) card on the Account page, allowing users with a Last.fm Pro subscription to configure their own API Key and Shared Secret.
- Secure credential storage: Custom API secrets are stored locally using the Windows PasswordVault and are excluded from plain-text settings exports.
- Transition notice & fallback lifecycle: Added a global notification banner and details dialog explaining the December 1st API transition. The banner and developer fallback key automatically deactivate once custom credentials are saved or after the December 1st cutoff.
- API key expiration handling: Added automatic session invalidation and re-authentication prompts for Last.fm API error codes 10 (Invalid API key) and 26 (Suspended API key).
- Project status & contact info: Updated the About page with the final archival status and developer contact link.
